name: Gunnison River — Gunnison Gorge
gaugeName: Gunnison River below Gunnison Tunnel, CO (USGS 09128000)
blurb: Hike-in wilderness gorge: boats are carried down the Chukar Trail; Class II–IV to the North Fork confluence. Wilderness permit required.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Boats carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail. Wilderness permit and fee required; BLM limit is 3 days/2 nights. Mileage: BLM Gunnison Gorge NCA brochure.

notices.title: Wilderness permit
notices.text: A Gunnison Gorge Wilderness permit and fee are required. The published limit is three days / two nights. Confirm current fees with BLM.

notices.title: Access limitation
notices.text: BLM: boats and gear carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail; no carts or wheeled devices in the wilderness; access road often requires 4WD.
